domains.name: Field Service Management Fundamentals
objectives: Field service types, modules and industry use cases
Field Service Management solution features
Process lifecycle, personas, roles, and related terminology
Work order initiation, qualification, scheduling and dispatch, and delivery and confirmation activities
Using the mobile application to fulfill work orders, record time worked, parts used, incidentals, etc
Managing agent skills and schedules

domains.name: Implementation Planning
objectives: Preparation activities stakeholders, and good practices
ServiceNow maturity levels
Integrations with applications and data sources

domains.name: Implementing Field Service Processes
objectives: Establishing foundational data (locations, groups, users, customer accounts, contacts, stockrooms, assets, etc.)
Configuring field service business process, assignment, and add-ons
Configuring work order templates, task dependencies, and SMART Assessment for FSM questionnaires
Configuring workforce management (agent skills, schedules, and events)
Configuring preventive maintenance for field service assets
Inventory management, part sourcing and transfer process
Configuring scheduling methods (schedule optimization, dynamic scheduling, route optimization) and task allocation preferences
Dispatcher workspace configuration and settings
Configuring Appointment Booking services
Time recording, rate types, labor rate cards, and time sheet policies

domains.name: Implementing Related Processes
objectives: Configuring agent feedback and tracking
Targeted communications
Contextual knowledge
Set up and usage of Now Agent mobile application, mobile offline

exam_name: ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – Field Service Management (CIS-FSM)
exam_rules: No notes, books, or external resources. Closed-book exam. ServiceNow platform access not provided during exam. Proctor monitors via webcam.
id_requirements: One valid, government-issued photo ID with full name and photo. Name must match exactly as registered.

lifecycle.summary: ServiceNow University still lists the exam as bookable: its course page for 'Certified Implementation Specialist - Field Service Management (CIS-FSM)' carries the live exam header 'EXAM : PEARSON VUE 1 HOUR 30 MINUTES Need To Register' and the description 'Learn about the Certified Implementation Specialist – Field Service Management exam, including its purpose, audience, recommended experience, registration process, and key policies.' No retirement wording appears.

official_study_resources.notes: Official ServiceNow University platform with courses aligned to each credential
official_study_resources.title: ServiceNow Training & Certification Portal

passing_score_scale: Scaled score; the cut score is not publicly disclosed and is not always 70%.
renewal_options: Pass a delta maintenance exam after each major ServiceNow release (approximately twice per year). Delta exams are shorter and free for certified candidates.

retake_policy.notes: 7-day waiting period after first failed attempt. Full exam fee required for retake. Certifications must be maintained via delta exams after each major release.
